IN THE UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE NORTHERN DISTRICT OF ILLINOIS
EASTERN DIVISION

RIDGELINE AEROSPACE COMPONENTS, INC.,
Plaintiff,
v.
HALLORAN PRECISION CASTINGS, LLC,
Defendant.

Case No. 1:26-cv-04412
Hon. Marisol Aguirre-Vance

STIPULATION OF DISMISSAL WITH PREJUDICE

Plaintiff Ridgeline Aerospace Components, Inc. and Defendant Halloran Precision Castings, LLC, by their undersigned counsel, stipulate under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 41(a)(1)(A)(ii) as follows.

1. All claims and counterclaims asserted in this action are dismissed WITH PREJUDICE.

2. Each party shall bear its own attorney's fees and costs.

3. This stipulation is signed by counsel for all parties who have appeared in this action. No party is an infant or incompetent person, and no receiver has been appointed, so no order of the Court is required for this dismissal to take effect.

4. The Court retains jurisdiction to enforce the parties' settlement agreement dated June 30, 2026 for a period of ninety (90) days from the date this stipulation is filed, as the parties have requested and as provided in that agreement.

Dated: July 2, 2026

TREMAINE & OKONKWO PLLC

/s/ Adaora Okonkwo
Adaora Okonkwo
Attorneys for Plaintiff Ridgeline Aerospace Components, Inc.

ACHTERBERG & VOSS LLP

/s/ Bettina Achterberg
Bettina Achterberg
Attorneys for Defendant Halloran Precision Castings, LLC

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE

I certify that on July 2, 2026 I served the foregoing on all counsel of record through the Court's electronic filing system.
